  /healthz:
    get:

      tags: [health]
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Healthy

            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/HealthStatus"

  # CLIENTS
  /clients:
    get:
      operationId: listClients
      tags: [clients]
      summary: List all clients
      parameters:
        - name: search
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: List of clients
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Client"
    post:
      operationId: createClient
      tags: [clients]
      summary: Create a new client
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateClientBody"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created client
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Client"

      responses:
        "200":
          description: Client details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Client"

    put:

            type: integer

components:
  schemas:
    HealthStatus:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
      required:
        - status

    ClientContact:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        clientId:
          type: integer
        firstName:
          type: string
        lastName:
          type: string
        preferredName:
          type: string
        position:
          type: string
        mobile:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
        isPrimaryContact:
          type: boolean
        isBillingContact:
          type: boolean
        isAuthorisedContact:
          type: boolean
        isAuthorisedRepresentative:
          type: boolean
        notes:
          type: string
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
      required:
        - id
        - clientId
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - isPrimaryContact
        - isBillingContact
        - isAuthorisedContact
        - isAuthorisedRepresentative
        - createdAt
        - updatedAt

    CreateClientContactBody:
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          type: string
        lastName:
          type: string
        preferredName:
          type: string
        position:
          type: string
        mobile:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
        isPrimaryContact:
          type: boolean
        isBillingContact:
          type: boolean
        isAuthorisedContact:
          type: boolean
        isAuthorisedRepresentative:
          type: boolean
        notes:
          type: string
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName

    Client:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        clientType:
          type: string
          enum: [individual, company]
        displayName:
          type: string
        firstName:
          type: string
        lastName:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
        phone:
          type: string
        secondaryContactName:
          type: string
        secondaryContactPhone:
          type: string
        secondaryContactEmail:
          type: string
        billingAddress:
          type: string
        notes:
          type: string
        companyName:
          type: string
        tradingName:
          type: string
        abn:
          type: string
        acn:
          type: string
        registeredOffice:
          type: string
        postalAddress:
          type: string
        mainPhone:
          type: string
        mainEmail:
          type: string
        archivedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

        createdAt:

        updatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

          type: array

        - id

      type: object
      properties:

        firstName:
          type: string
        lastName:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
        phone:
          type: string
        secondaryContactName:

        secondaryContactPhone:
          type: string
        secondaryContactEmail:
          type: string
        billingAddress:
          type: string
        notes:
          type: string
        companyName:
          type: string
        tradingName:
          type: string
        abn:
          type: string
        acn:
          type: string
        registeredOffice:
          type: string
        postalAddress:
          type: string
        mainPhone:
          type: string
        mainEmail:
          type: string

              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/HealthStatus"

  # CLIENTS
  /clients:
    get:
      operationId: listClients
      tags: [clients]
      summary: List all clients
      parameters:

          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: List of clients
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Client"
    post:
      operationId: createClient
      tags: [clients]
      summary: Create a new client
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateClientBody"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created client
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Client"

  /clients/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: getClient
      tags: [clients]
      summary: Get a client by ID
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Client details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Client"
        "404":
          description: Not found
    put:
      operationId: updateClient
      tags: [clients]
      summary: Update a client

          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer

        required: true
        content:

            schema:

          content:
            application/json:

      summary: Delete a client
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
